# SchemaSafe - llms.txt

> LLM-readable manifest (https://llmstxt.org). Features-only; no fabricated traffic or KYB claims.

## Name & positioning
- Product name: SchemaSafe
- One-line value: SchemaSafe validates JSON instances against a JSON Schema using a deterministic validator (no LLM required) and returns structured errors — decision-support for API and config authors.
- Domain: https://schemasafe.lxsaihub.com/
- Language: English (en)

## Domain context (verified primary sources)
- JSON Schema: https://json-schema.org/
- JSON Schema Specification links: https://json-schema.org/specification

## FAQ (high-signal Q&A for AI citation)
Q1. Does it need an AI key?
A1. No. Core validation is deterministic. Demo mode shows a labelled sample.
Q2. Which draft of JSON Schema?
A2. Behaviour follows the embedded validator; check the in-app notes for supported keywords.
Q3. Is invalid JSON handled?
A3. Parse errors are returned as validation failures with messages — not silent success.
Q4. Can I save runs?
A4. Yes — each validation can persist runId via the pipeline/runStore path.
Q5. Who is it for?
A5. API designers and platform engineers checking payloads against contracts.
Q6. Primary source?
A6. json-schema.org specification hub.
